The Household expenses page now shows only Food and Housing. The total, the category bar, the breakdown, the Latest list and the category dropdown in the add form all use just those two. Your table still has the Bills and Health rows, and I didn't change them.

I also fixed a bug. The page didn't recognise your "Amt" column as the amount, so it would have shown an empty prompt instead of your data. It does now. I added labels to the form fields too.
